provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning an Automobile Workshop

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定对手艺生意有幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常资产邀约（So you want to own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own an automobile workshop.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你想拥有X"开场，X选观众自认了解、消费过的手艺生意
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是观众有画面感的日常生意，不要选陌生资产

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众心里"老板躺赚"的画面原样演出来
examples.expression_mechanism: 天真画面重演（玻璃办公室数钱）
examples.example_text: the owner sitting in a glass office counting a very comfortable pile of cash.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习替观众演出他们的天真想象，让后面的拆穿像自我发现
examples.negative_instruction: 画面必须是观众真实会想的版本，不可替观众编造可笑幻想

examples.psychological_goal: 用独立短句叫停幻想、宣布反转开始
examples.expression_mechanism: 真相转向短句（Here is the truth.）
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用极短独立句做认知换挡，停顿即信号
examples.negative_instruction: 转向句后必须立刻兑现真相，不可空转

examples.psychological_goal: 用每美元残值给出核心落差
examples.expression_mechanism: 规模vs残值反差（1150亿流水 vs 10-20美分）
examples.example_text: the average shop owner, after paying for everything, frequently keeps somewhere between 10 and 20 cents of every dollar
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把行业规模与业主残值并排，用每美元换算让落差可感
examples.negative_instruction: 数字必须给区间与口径，不要用整数夸张

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个人名速写让分类学有画面感
examples.expression_mechanism: 人名速写干幽默（a guy named Dave）
examples.example_text: The neighborhood garage, the one tucked behind the gas station run by a guy named Dave
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用具体人名+位置速写让抽象业态立刻可感
examples.negative_instruction: 幽默只能是速写式，不可嘲笑店主本人

examples.psychological_goal: 用可见/不可见对比给出全片论点
examples.expression_mechanism: 可见部分vs决定部分的二分判词
examples.example_text: Fixing cars is the visible part of the business.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把"你以为的主体"降级为可见部分，为不可见部分立威
examples.negative_instruction: 判词后必须真的解剖不可见部分，不能停在口号

examples.psychological_goal: 把层叠清单落成一记总量锤
examples.expression_mechanism: 总量锤+数据来源（2000+真实创业）
examples.example_text: a total startup investment for a medium-sized shop of between $211,000 and $654,000
examples.usage_instruction: 学习枚举之后必给总量落锤，并注明数据出处
examples.negative_instruction: 总量必须来自可溯数据，不可凭感觉取整

examples.psychological_goal: 用路标预告开启全片最重要的数字段
examples.expression_mechanism: 预告式路标（数字变得重要+陷入麻烦）
examples.example_text: Here is where the numbers become particularly important, and where many shop owners get into serious trouble.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在重场段前用一句"重要性+危险性"双预告拉注意力
examples.negative_instruction: 路标预告的段落必须真的是高潮，不可滥用

examples.psychological_goal: 完成名义工资到真实成本的关键转译
examples.expression_mechanism: 名义→实际转译（$30/时 → $45/生产工时）
examples.example_text: a technician earning $30 an hour, about $62,000 a year in base pay, actually costs the business closer to $45 per productive hour.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给名义数字再给有效数字，让"你以为的成本"被纠正
examples.negative_instruction: 转译的两个数字口径必须一致（时薪对时薪）

examples.psychological_goal: 用挂牌vs实收揭示悄悄亏钱的缝隙
examples.expression_mechanism: 条件演算（若挂牌$150×70%效率=实收$105）
examples.example_text: If your posted rate is $150, but your technicians are only 70% efficient, you are effectively earning $105 per productive hour.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"If...but..."条件句现场演算，让观众自己看到差值
examples.negative_instruction: 演算参数必须前文已建立（70%效率），不可空降

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连短句把留存飞轮钉成记忆点
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连排比判词（进门→管道→真钱）
examples.example_text: The oil change gets the car in the door. The inspection builds the pipeline of future work.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"引流品→机制→利润所在"的三连短句收束一个论证
examples.negative_instruction: 排比每句必须推进一层，不可同义重复

examples.psychological_goal: 把抗衰退论证落到普通人的处境上
examples.expression_mechanism: 共情落点（旧车得开去上班）
examples.example_text: People who cannot afford a new car still need their old one to get to work.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把宏观判断（抗衰退）落到具体人的具体需求
examples.negative_instruction: 落点必须真实克制，不可煽情

examples.psychological_goal: 用具象场景让"现金流窒息"可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 死举升机场景（4小时零产出）
examples.example_text: that lift is dead for 4 hours. The car cannot come down safely. The bay produces zero revenue
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"一个工位停摆"的微观场景呈现抽象的现金流风险
examples.negative_instruction: 场景必须物理上成立（车拆半空无法落地），不可夸张

examples.psychological_goal: 用同词反转戳破幸存假象
examples.expression_mechanism: 同词反转判词（okay vs survivable）
examples.example_text: The math looks okay until one slow month revealed that okay was never actually okay. It was just survivable.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一个词的自反（okay从来不是okay）制造判词张力
examples.negative_instruction: 反转必须建立在前面账本已算清的基础上

examples.psychological_goal: 给出全片主题句：两种技能的鸿沟
examples.expression_mechanism: 主题判词+独立短句加重（Two entirely different skill sets.）
examples.example_text: the gap between being a good mechanic and being a competent business operator. Two entirely different skill sets.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把全片归因压成一句"A与B的鸿沟"+短句定性
examples.negative_instruction: 主题句必须放在证据铺满之后，不可提前

examples.psychological_goal: 用系统vs劳动定性真正的造富模式
examples.expression_mechanism: 来源对调判词（系统而非劳动）
examples.example_text: The money comes from the system, not from the labor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"来自X而非Y"的对偶句给经营模式定性
examples.negative_instruction: 对偶两项必须前文都已论证（多店系统/单店劳动）

examples.psychological_goal: 用删除式枚举呈现模式根基被抽走
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定枚举（No oil, no spark plugs, no timing belt...）
examples.example_text: An electric vehicle has none of those things. No oil, no spark plugs, no timing belt, no exhaust.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把"消失的东西"逐项点名，让冲击可清点
examples.negative_instruction: 被删除的项必须正是前文论证过的收入锚点

examples.psychological_goal: 用平行真理+对比金句完成最终回收
examples.expression_mechanism: 平行断言+比较级金句（not the best X, the best Y）
examples.example_text: Cars will always break. Technology will always evolve. The workshops that survive will not necessarily be the best mechanics. They will be the best businesses.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用两句永恒断言铺垫，再用"不是最好的A，是最好的B"收全片
examples.negative_instruction: 金句的A/B必须正是全片张力两极（手艺/经营）
